contact.basis: Original site terrain sampled in the open event plaza between the two warehouses.

verticalDatum: GSI Japanese national elevation datum in meters, referenced to mean sea level in Tokyo Bay.
attribution: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI), DEM5A elevation tiles
method: Original DEM5A CSV landsurface samples rotated into the fixed native warehouse frame with bilinear interpolation. Neither warehouse grade nor plaza is flattened.
limitations: The renderer uses a 2 m display mesh and the native DEM is a 5 m airborne laser survey. Positions and grade under buildings remain approximate.
Cells with partial coastal coverage are interpolated using the valid GSI weights. Fully missing pixels use the display water level.
demSource: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan, DEM5A 5 m airborne laser survey

sourceNoData.basis: Raw source retains every e. Only fully missing off-pier view samples use sea level for the review renderer. Land along the wharf uses the measured elevations.
